items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: And then after he kept coming, I used to pick on my banjo and make it make it on his horn. And you know, less than four months time Joe could blow.

ctx.x: Yeah. I said, you come around by my house. Let me see how you work. I said, I put a banjo. He told me, all right, little Joe come around there. And then after he kept coming, I used to pick on my banjo and make it make it on his horn. And you know, less than four months time Joe could blow. And then Joe told me and told all the rest of me, he said, when I learn how this thing blow this thing good, he said, I'm going to smoke muddyshick and drink good whiskey.
